description: Mandatory consultation with the naming agent before any artifact is created, renamed, or registered. Returns approved name(s), the authoritative rule source, collision check, and any registry rows the naming agent will write. Every other governed tool that creates files must call this first.
checklist: 1. Validate the payload contains: artifact_kind (file|directory|module|agent|prompt|api_endpoint|db_table|db_column|db_index|db_migration|error_code|config_var|gui_element_id|governed_tool|governance_rule|other), proposed_purpose (one-line description), scope_path (the .ai/instruct.md scope), and optional candidate_name
2. Hand the payload to the naming agent in Mode 3 (Propose)
3. Receive the naming agent's structured response: { approved_name, alternates[], rule_source (path#section), collision_check (clear|conflict_with), registry_changes_required[] }
4. If collision_check != 'clear', refuse to advance — return to caller for re-proposal
5. Persist the response into the caller's task envelope under context.artifacts[*].naming_source so downstream stages (validator, reviewer) can verify attribution
6. Call log-action to record the consultation (artifact_kind, approved_name, rule_source)
7. Return the response to the caller — caller proceeds with creation; naming agent will write any registry rows in its post-stage sweep
